label: rare copy-phase reset on z/x/f inputs in length-9 sequences
explanation: Extremely sparse (0.03% of steps) with tiny magnitudes. It fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely when L = 9 (97% of mass). It is concentrated at recall_idx 2 (57% of mass) and recall_idx 7-8 (32%), and mostly when the input token is z (60% of mass), then x or f. It never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or when L <= 6. The predicate copy & L=9 & input in {z,x,f} gets about 78% of the mass but only 2% precision. The narrowest good-looking rule (L=9, recall_idx 2, input z) reaches F1 of only 0.21. Most steps that match these conditions do not fire, so whatever triggers it is not captured by the token or position variables.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=z (+4.82), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+3.47), phase=2 & in_tok=f (+2.50), phase=2 & in_tok=s (+2.24), phase=2 & in_tok=e (+2.14), prev_tok=j (+1.92).
